mustFix.fix: While the header is not .is-scrolled over the deep hero, set links to #F4F6F8 and hours to a muted paper tone >= 4.5:1; switch to ink only once .is-scrolled gives the header a paper background

elevate.move: Art-direct the real frames as one Alaskan shoot: grade each into a two-tone of its section's season colour (glacier winter, spruce breakup, warm paper summer) so every photo is a page of the car-year issue, and tie the vertical unclip to the rail so the photo opens as the temperature ticks to that season

Turn each season story into a magazine spread: photo bleeding off one edge, the season temperature set huge in Bodoni across the gutter over the image as the one deliberate grid-break, copy column tight beside it; alternate bleed side and spread width so winter, breakup and summer read as three different pages
